parsed.rationale: Both `ShowContainerProtocol` and `TrackContainerProtocol` in package `Playback` share four fields identically (`isStale:Bool`, `lastRefreshedAt:Date?`, `pageToken:String?`, and `item`) with the sole structural difference being the concrete type of `item` (`Show` vs `Track`). This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single protocol with `associatedtype Item` captures the shared shape, and each concrete conformer binds `Item` to `Show` or `Track` respectively. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so the refactor is safe. Introducing `ContainerProtocol` eliminates the duplicated declarations and allows generic algorithms over any container regardless of item type.
